accounts.add_help: {provider}'s own sign-in opens in a terminal. To add an account other than the one your browser is signed in to, open the sign-in link in a private window.
accounts.copy_tooltip: Copy the command that starts {provider} as this account
accounts.default_tooltip: The account {provider} uses unless you pick another
accounts.duplicate_body: This folder is signed in to {account} too, so it shares those limits. Sign in with another account in a private browser window, or remove it.
accounts.hide_tooltip: Hide this account. Its folder stays as it is.
accounts.hint: Sign in again to see this account's usage.
accounts.login_intro: Headroom: signing in to {provider} as "{account}". To use an account other than the one your browser is signed in to, open the sign-in link in a private window.
accounts.no_terminal_body: Set $TERMINAL to your terminal emulator and try again.
accounts.remove_tooltip: Remove this account and delete its folder
accounts.sign_in_tooltip: Opens the sign-in in a terminal

bar.empty: Headroom: no AI provider sign-in found

network.body: Check your connection. Headroom will try again shortly.
network.title: Can't reach the provider

no_plan.body: This account's plan has no usage quota for this product. Headroom checks again every hour.
no_plan.title: No quota on this plan

parse.body: The usage format may have changed. Please report it on GitHub.
parse.title: Unexpected response

rate_limited.body: Too many requests. Headroom will wait, then try again.
rate_limited.title: Throttled

server.body: The provider returned an error. Headroom will try again shortly.
server.title: Service error

panel.empty_body: Headroom reads the sign-ins your AI coding tools have already saved. Sign in to one and it appears here.

antigravity.hint: Run `agy` once and sign in with Google.

claude.hint: Run `claude` once to sign in or renew the session.

codex.hint: Run `codex login` and sign in with ChatGPT.

resets.hint: You have a reset credit. Spend it on the usage page to get this limit back now.
resets.label: Reset credits

bar_accounts.description: Which accounts the bar shows when a provider has several. The panel always shows them all.
bar_accounts.label: Accounts

bar_style.description: What each item shows next to its logo.
bar_style.label: Style

critical_percent.description: Usage at or above this turns the error color and sends a notification.
critical_percent.label: Critical at (%)

display.description: Whether numbers, rings and meters show what you've used or what's left. Colors always follow usage.
display.label: Show amounts as

max_items.description: The most items the capsule shows. If more qualify, it keeps the ones closest to their limits.
max_items.label: Maximum items

notify.description: Notify once when a window crosses the critical level, and again when it resets.
notify.label: Notifications

notify_reset_credits.description: Notify once when a reset credit has two days left before it expires.
notify_reset_credits.label: Reset credit reminders

provider.description: Where it appears. Off: never fetched or shown.

refresh_minutes.description: Minutes between fetches for each provider. Failed fetches retry sooner.
refresh_minutes.label: Refresh every (minutes)

warn_percent.description: Usage at or above this turns the warning color.
warn_percent.label: Warning at (%)

window.description: Which usage window each item shows.
window.label: Window
